rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

card.title: Emotional Seniority
card.instruction: Carry yourself as the person who understands this relationship best, and treat your interpretation as the one that should settle disagreements.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You asking for your spare key back tells me we're frightened of getting closer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm frightened of paying for a third lock.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I understand us better than that. I'll keep the key; we need to practise trust.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then trust me with your spare.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Exchanging keys is exactly the commitment I knew we were ready for.

card.title: Emotional Seniority
card.instruction: Carry yourself as the person who understands this relationship best, and treat your interpretation as the one that should settle disagreements.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our dinner silence means we're comfortable together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm angry about your joke. Cancel tomorrow's dinner with your sister.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Telling me proves we're secure. Dinner stays; we're ready for family.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then you're explaining to her why I'm silent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll explain that you trust her with your anger. I'll ask her to seat you beside her; we're ready for that closeness.

card.title: I Was There
card.instruction: Treat your presence during a difficult time as an enduring claim on loyalty, honesty, and consideration.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I stayed all night when your business failed. Are you borrowing against the house again?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's only a small loan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At four in the morning, 'small' meant your entire savings. I deserve the figure.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll show you the application. You don't get a veto.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then show me before you sign. That night earned me a conversation while there's still a choice.

card.title: I Was There
card.instruction: Treat your presence during a difficult time as an enduring claim on loyalty, honesty, and consideration.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I drove through that storm after your dad died. Help me move Saturday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm taking the kids swimming.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I missed my anniversary to sit with you. Swimming can wait.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll pay for movers. I can't miss another day with them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the money. Bring the kids after swimming. I was family that night; I expect all of you at my leaving tea.

transfer.response: Give me the honest voice you used at four in the morning. {counter}
